confirmation.description: Immutable issuance receipt. A retry never creates or extends a code.

state.description: Live availability, checked now; not part of the stored receipt.

country.description: Null or omitted: derive from the game's language. Other codes must occur in the client's table.

AccountSummary.description: A projection of existing account state: no keys, password hashes, device tokens or invented dates/presence.

code.description: Omit for a generated code. Codes are case insensitive and stored in uppercase.

uses.description: Number of accounts that can claim it. Omit for unlimited; each account can claim it once.

days.description: Days from the first successful creation. Omit for no expiry; retries keep the original expiry.

uses.description: Number of sign-ups. Omit for unlimited.

GiveBpByIdRequest.description: The dashboard always targets the stable account number, never a renameable player or login label.

uses.description: Remaining sign-ups, not the original limit. Null means unlimited.

additional_cards.description: Additional card copies, excluding the starter deck. u16 card rows * u32 counts fit below 2^48, exactly in JS.

online.description: Live presence is unknown without a running hub. Never infer it from saved accounts.

expires_at.description: Idle expiry, refreshed by an authenticated request; capped by the absolute session lifetime.
